audit: UX, UI quality and product usability

tested_revision.simulation_image: digital-goods-shop 7596c7c4ee64, web c401e0174446 (built from c827db2; the later JavaScript and label changes do not affect the script-free simulation)

gates.title: Complete UI and workflow inventory
gates.criteria: Every critical user workflow inventoried and tested; no critical journey blocked by an unresolved usability defect.
evidence: ux-workflow-inventory.md: 85 pages, 105 actions, 30 critical journeys for buyer, seller and staff
Crawl of 73 pages x 4 roles (evidence/crawl-after.json)
Every journey mapped to a browser test, PHPUnit test or simulation scenario

gates.title: Interaction feedback and action states
gates.criteria: Critical interactions give accurate feedback and leave a consistent state after success, failure or cancellation.
evidence: UX-02 confirmation for 10 irreversible actions (no JS needed), cancel = close
UX-06 second submits dropped on every POST form
Busy indicator after 200 ms, cleared on errors, downloads and back/forward cache
Success messages come from the server after the change
Disabled payment option names its reason
open: UX-18 server-side duplicate protection for two staff money forms (Low, not reproduced)

gates.title: Forms, passwords and input
gates.criteria: Critical forms completable with supported input methods; validation failures understandable and recoverable.
evidence: Show/hide password: keyboard (Enter, Space), aria-pressed and label, value kept, masked again on submit, spellcheck off while visible
autocomplete: email, current-password, new-password, one-time-code; inputmode decimal and numeric
Password rules stated before submission; reset answers known and unknown emails alike (simulation P3)
Server-side validation, field messages with aria-describedby, error summary focused (UX-07)
Input kept after errors; unsaved long text guarded (UX-12)
open: UX-17 optional fields not marked consistently (Low)

gates.title: Automatic refresh and real-time synchronisation
gates.criteria: Workflows needing automatic updates meet the documented freshness target, and stay correct, authorised and recoverable.
evidence: ux-realtime-sync-report.md: polling every 10 s, 26 pages, documented targets
Staff to user (payment, ticket reply, product approval) and user to staff (new order) tested in the browser
Several tabs, connection loss and recovery, session end, rate limit tested
Authorisation of versions tested (NotificationCentreTest, UxAuditTest)
UX-04 fixed: seller pages were stale
open: UX-15 header navigation after a role change updates on the next page load (Low)

gates.title: Notifications and alerts
gates.criteria: Notifications accurate, timely, accessible and consistent with the underlying events.
evidence: Toasts only for real notifications, once per notification across tabs; badge equal in all tabs (live.spec.js)
Notification centre keeps every message; links stay inside the shop; secret links excluded (NotificationCentreTest)
One polite status region; flash messages role=status or alert; background refreshes announced once, briefly
Sound and seller email preferences respected; UX-24 label fixed
UX-23 no false 'Connection lost' when rate-limited

gates.title: Responsive desktop, tablet and mobile
gates.criteria: Critical workflows work at supported viewport sizes without inaccessible controls, clipping, unusable forms or broken navigation.
evidence: ux-responsive-audit.md: 6 viewports incl. landscape, both schemes; 0 overflow, 0 axe violations, text spacing pass
Purchase completed on a 375 px touch viewport (ux.spec.js)
limits: Chromium device emulation only; no iOS Safari, Firefox or real devices

gates.title: Dark mode, themes and visual consistency
gates.criteria: Required themes render correctly and consistently; coherent design system with verified contrast and states.
evidence: Light, dark, and same-as-device; server-rendered attribute, so no flash of the wrong theme
axe contrast in dark at 375 and 1280 px (crawl) and at 1280 px in CI: 0 violations, confirmation panels opened
Theme setting survives reloads and applies to every page (ux.spec.js)
One stylesheet with colour tokens; components reused (field, select, textarea, status, confirm)
decisions: UX-19 theme per browser, set in the footer

gates.title: Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA target)
gates.criteria: Critical barriers resolved, automated checks pass, required manual checks documented.
evidence: axe WCAG 2.2 AA: 0 violations in CI (light, dark, phone) and in the crawl (was 26, UX-01)
Keyboard-only purchase journey; focus management; search, confirmations and toggle by keyboard
gates.reason: No screen reader (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is available in this environment, and automated scans alone do not establish conformance. The screen-reader script in ux-accessibility-report.md has to be run.

gates.title: Navigation, discoverability and information architecture
gates.criteria: Critical journeys completable without broken navigation, confusing labels or dead ends.
evidence: Current page marked (aria-current) in main and section menus; section menus scroll to the current entry on phones
Deep link kept through the sign-in (ux.spec.js); filters live in the URL, so back and forward keep them
404, 403, 419, 429 and 500 pages say what happened, with a way back and a request id
Search: empty result with 'Clear filters'; result count announced
Role menus show only permitted sections (StaffRolesTest)

gates.title: Data freshness, consistency and state management
gates.criteria: Critical views stay consistent with the server within their freshness requirement; concurrency and failure do not corrupt the interface.
evidence: Single source of truth (server); no client cache, no optimistic updates
One poll and one refresh at a time; version compares state, so missed or repeated updates are harmless
Typing protected from refresh; form tokens renewed after re-sign-in
Financial and permission state always read from the server; concurrent staff decisions refused with a message (UxAuditTest)

gates.title: Loading, empty, offline and error states
gates.criteria: Every critical workflow has meaningful loading, success, empty and error behaviour.
evidence: Busy indicator on slow submits; no skeletons that could misrepresent content
Empty states with a next step (cart, orders, wishlist, notifications, search, seller lists)
Connection lost and restored messages with automatic retry and back-off
Expired session: warning before (UX-22), message after (UX-03), explained 419 page
Error pages without technical detail (request id only); partial delivery failure does not block the other items (simulation P1)

gates.title: Admin and multi-role experience
gates.criteria: Every role completes its authorised workflows; the UI reflects real permissions and backend state.
evidence: Five staff roles with permission-filtered menus and server-side checks (StaffRolesTest)
Destructive staff actions confirmed (UX-02); sensitive ones need a recent password
Live staff lists (orders, payouts, disputes, tickets, products, sellers, reviews)
Concurrent decisions refused with a message (UxAuditTest::test_u12)
Audit log with actor and change; bulk actions report skipped rows

gates.title: Internationalisation and content quality
gates.criteria: Supported locales present correct, consistent content and usable layouts.
evidence: One supported locale (English); every string translatable and listed in lang/en.json (TranslationCatalogTest)
Plurals via trans_choice; fixed money and date formats, times labelled UTC
Text spacing (WCAG 1.4.12) passes on 73 pages; buttons wrap
UX-13 and UX-24 wording fixes
not_applicable: Right-to-left layout and further locales: not supported by the product
open: UX-16 times in UTC only (Low, product decision)

gates.title: Real-world UX testing
gates.criteria: Critical journeys pass reproducible end-to-end tests; no unresolved high-impact usability defect.
evidence: Browser tests for: first purchase, login and recovery, editing and deleting, staff changes seen by users, two sessions, failed submission, network loss and recovery, phone, theme, keyboard-only, deep links, session expiry
Simulation: 101 scenarios on the production stack
Screenshots, console errors and failed requests recorded per page (crawl)
gates.reason: Two required parts could not be done here: screen-reader behaviour of the important interactions (no screen reader available) and sessions with real users (none available).

gates.title: Final UX regression review
gates.criteria: The candidate passes the mandatory UX regression suite without unacceptable regressions.
evidence: Browser suite 37/37 on 66ce3a5 (evidence/browser-suite-final.txt)
Crawl 584 page views on 66ce3a5: 0 overflow, 0 axe violations, 0 console errors (evidence/crawl-after.json)
PHPUnit 322/322; Pint, PHPStan level 5, ASCII clean
Simulation 101/101 (evidence/simulation-ux-candidate.md)
Security gate 9/9 PASS (evidence/security-gate-ux-candidate.json)
Performance gate: asset budgets met (enhance.js 29,437 B / 7,668 B gzip of 30,000 / 8,000); Web Vitals A/B unchanged within noise (evidence/webvitals-ab.json)
Regression found and fixed during the audit: UX-14
gates.note: enhance.js uses 98 % of its size budget

ci.suite: tests/browser/run.sh: nojs.spec.js, live.spec.js, ux.spec.js, a11y.spec.js in projects light, dark and mobile; screenshots and traces uploaded on failure

notes: No exception was approved; the audit does not approve its own exceptions.
